name: Marketing For Life Sciences
description: A life sciences adaptation of the marketing plugin for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech teams. Extends the full general marketing toolkit with regulatory compliance (FDA/EMA), MLR review workflows, HCP engagement, KOL strategy, congress marketing, and pharma-specific KPIs. Designed primarily for Cowork, also compatible with Claude Code.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**, **10 commands** and **13 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (7): `brand-voice` (Apply and enforce brand voice, style guide, and messaging pillars across content), `campaign-planning` (Plan marketing campaigns with objectives, audience segmentation, channel strategy, content calendars, and success metrics), `competitive-analysis` (Research competitors and compare positioning, messaging, content strategy, and market presence), `content-creation` (Draft marketing content across channels — blog posts, social media, email newsletters, landing pages, press releases, and case…), `medical-affairs-liaison` (Plan and manage medical affairs activities including MSL engagement, KOL mapping and tiering, advisory board planning, and medical…), `performance-analytics` (Analyze marketing performance with key metrics, trend analysis, and optimization recommendations), `regulatory-compliance` (Pharmaceutical and medical device regulatory compliance for marketing materials)
- **Commands** (10): `_brand-review` (Review content against your brand voice, style guide, and messaging pillars), `_campaign-plan` (Generate a full campaign brief with objectives, channels, content calendar, and success metrics), `_competitive-brief` (Research competitors and generate a positioning and messaging comparison), `_congress-plan` (Plan conference and congress marketing activities for life sciences), `_draft-content` (Draft blog posts, social media, email newsletters, landing pages, press releases, and case studies), `_email-sequence` (Design and draft multi-email sequences for nurture flows, onboarding, drip campaigns, and more), `_kol-strategy` (Develop a KOL engagement strategy for a therapeutic area or product), `_mlr-review` (Simulate medical-legal-regulatory review of promotional content), and 2 more
- **MCP servers** (13): `slack`, `canva`, `figma`, `hubspot`, `amplitude`, `notion`, `ahrefs`, `similarweb`, and 5 more

Installs with `claude plugin install marketing-for-life-sciences@claude-community` from `RationalEyes/claude-business-plugins` (`marketing-life-sciences`).
